title: Prep: split near-limit files so the phase stays under 400 lines
player_outcome: Nothing visible. Later P1 packages can add code to ItemUseSystem and GameWorld without hitting the CI file-length limit or merge-conflicting on one giant method.
design: Move class PlayerEntity (src/Strata.Core/Session/GameWorld.cs lines 19-112) unchanged into a new src/Strata.Core/Session/PlayerEntity.cs in the same namespace. GameWorld.cs goes from 387 to about 280 lines.

Split src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Interaction/ItemUseSystem.cs (375 lines). Move Shoot() and FindAmmo() into a new partial ItemUseSystem.Shooting.cs. Move Consume(), the Refused event, Summon(), StartEvent() and ConsumeHeld() into a new partial ItemUseSystem.Consumables.cs. Use(), UseTool(), Place(), PlacementCell(), ObjectAnchor() and DominantFace() stay in ItemUseSystem.cs (about 230 lines).
Change no behaviour: code moves only, same namespaces, same using lists.
Run the full local CI: check_file_length, build, Core tests, validate, smoke basic/combat.
tests: No new tests; the whole existing suite must pass unchanged.
verification: python3 tools/ci/check_file_length.py: all four touched files are under 300 lines
dotnet build Strata.sln && dotnet test tests/Strata.Core.Tests
Godot headless smoke basic.cmds and combat.cmds print SMOKE PASS
risks: Every later Core package touches these files. Land and merge this first, before any other package branches.
